Rig dump for the rifle viewmodel, assembled from Workspace.Rifle_VM_final in Studio.
Geometry is Cube 3D output (GenerationService, prompt: modern military assault carbine),
extracted as OBJ via EditableMesh, converted to GLB and uploaded through Open Cloud as
Model assets; the mesh ids below are the auto-created Mesh assets inside those uploads.
Albedo textures are the Cube 3D TextureContent maps, uploaded as Image assets. Cube 3D
produced no SurfaceAppearance PBR maps for this run, so TextureID carries the albedo.
Positions are relative to Main, which is the receiver mesh and the model's PrimaryPart.
Muzzle faces -Z, matching the pistol template convention.

The reciprocating part is named Slide (not Bolt): ViewmodelBuilder.MESH_BONES binds
Slide -> slide, shared with the pistol and PoseLibrary.

Regenerate assets/viewmodels/rifle.model.json from this with:
    python3 scripts/build_viewmodel.py rifle
